note: The British Virgin Islands: an employer needs a work permit for anyone not a Belonger or Virgin Islander (Labour Code 2010, s. 171), festival work included. No days without it are modelled. British citizens and the other territories' passports, though of the same nationality, need it too and are named; the territory's own are home.

sources.title: Government of the Virgin Islands, Department of Labour Urges Employers to Comply With Labour Code
sources.said: Failure to do so will render persons in direct violation of Section 171 of the 2010 Labour Code. ... all employers operating on the Festival Grounds are urged to apply for and obtain a work permit for non-Belongers or non-Virgin Islander that they are seeking to employ.
